- Policy type and changed settings
- Previous and proposed values
- Target users/devices, exclusions, and assignment filters
- Intended security or operational outcome
- Pilot results and rollback method
- Relevant error codes or sanitized screenshots/exports

I’ll assess scope, security benefit, compatibility, overlapping-policy conflicts, user impact, deployment risk, monitoring signals, and rollback readiness.
